input.question: If our atmosphere was 78% Oxygen instead of nitrogen, would we be able to hold our breath longer?
input.ground_truth: If we hadn't been killed off by fires raging across continents every time there was a lightning storm, or exterminated by gigantic insects, sure. P.S. Insects are limited in size by their relatively inefficient pulmonary systems (and, possibly, their exoskeletons).
